# Metacrafter

> Python CLI and library that labels columns of files and databases with semantic
> datatypes from the Metacrafter Registry (registry.apicrafter.io) and finds personal data.

Agent entry points: the MCP server (`metacrafter mcp`), the HTTP API (`/v2/classify`),
and the skills in the repository's skills/ directory. Report schema: https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/schema/report-v3.schema.json

## Docs

- [export atlas](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/commands/export-atlas.md): Export a scan report to Apache Atlas
- [export datahub](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/commands/export-datahub.md): Export a scan report to DataHub
- [export openmetadata](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/commands/export-openmetadata.md): Export a scan report to OpenMetadata
- [CLI Reference](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/commands.md): Index of Metacrafter CLI commands
- [rules](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/commands/rules.md): List loaded rules and show aggregate statistics
- [scan bulk](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/commands/scan-bulk.md): Scan every supported file in a directory tree
- [scan file](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/commands/scan-file.md): Scan a data file and classify its fields
- [scan mongodb](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/commands/scan-mongodb.md): Scan MongoDB collections
- [scan sql](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/commands/scan-sql.md): Scan SQL database tables via SQLAlchemy
- [server](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/commands/server.md): Run the Metacrafter HTTP classification API
- [Shared CLI options](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/commands/shared-options.md): Flags shared by scan commands
- [Comparison](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/comparison.md): Metacrafter compared with Presidio, YData Profiling, DataProfiler, and similar tools
- [Architecture](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/development/architecture.md): Metacrafter components, data flow, rule system, and extension points
- [Community](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/development/community.md): Support, commercial API, and related projects
- [Contributing](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/development/contributing.md): Development setup, tests, and documentation
- [Data File Formats](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/formats.md): Formats and compression codecs supported via iterabledata
- [Basic usage](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/getting-started/basic-usage.md): Configuration, output formats, and everyday scan options
- [Best practices](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/getting-started/best-practices.md): Recommended scan settings, rule hygiene, and production use
- [Cookbook](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/getting-started/cookbook.md): Task-oriented index by role and goal
- [Installation](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/getting-started/installation.md): Install Metacrafter with pip and optional extras
- [Migrating to 1.0](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/getting-started/migration.md): Breaking changes from 0.0.x and how to adapt
- [Quick Start](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/getting-started/quick-start.md): Task-oriented first success paths for Metacrafter
- [Troubleshooting](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/getting-started/troubleshooting.md): Common errors, exit codes, and how to debug scans
- [When to use Metacrafter](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/getting-started/when-to-use.md): Metacrafter vs Presidio, YData Profiling, DataProfiler, and similar tools
- [API server](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/integrations/api.md): HTTP classification API and remote CLI scans
- [Apache Atlas](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/integrations/atlas.md): Export scan results as Apache Atlas classifications and attributes
- [DataHub](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/integrations/datahub.md): Export scan results to DataHub tags, glossary terms, and properties
- [LLM classification](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/integrations/llm.md): RAG-based classification with OpenAI, Ollama, and other providers
- [OpenMetadata](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/integrations/openmetadata.md): Export scan results to OpenMetadata tags and glossary terms
- [Registry](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/integrations/registry.md): Resolve scan results against metacrafter-registry datatypes
- [Report format](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/integrations/report.md): Scan report version 3, output formats and crosswalk exports
- [Custom rules](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/integrations/rules.md): YAML rules, match engines, validators, registry detectors and scoring
- [Python SDK](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/integrations/sdk.md): Use Metacrafter as a Python library
- [License](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/license.md): Apache License 2.0 for Metacrafter
- [Catalog export](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/use-cases/catalog-export.md): Push scan labels into DataHub, OpenMetadata, or Apache Atlas
- [Database scanning](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/use-cases/database-scanning.md): Classify columns in SQL databases and MongoDB
- [File scanning](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/use-cases/file-scanning.md): Classify columns in CSV, JSON, Parquet, Excel, and compressed files
- [PII detection](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/use-cases/pii-detection.md): Scan files and databases for personal identifiable information
- [Semantic labeling](https://apicrafter.github.io/metacrafter/use-cases/semantic-labeling.md): Identify emails, identifiers, dates, and other semantic types
